1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The rollback succeeded, and the service is now healthy (error rate 0.2%) in all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer was paged. (Note: the first incident creation attempt timed out, so I verified it hadn't been created and retried successfully.)

The service is now back to a healthy state on v2.3.0 in all regions.
